verdict: consistent on the text as enciphered: 79 signs (2 under the stain) for 77 letters, 18 groups = 18 words, one letter per shape (71/71 repeated); the cipher reads يا هادمي ها دمي ... وخلصني اخير مما تعذبني وتمغصني تصل وترجع بهجرانك تنغصني بسي عسل وزنا بيسه ت..; ي has two shapes (initial L-hook, cup-hook); tentative in the singletons and the end
notes: Rows 2-6 of image 0084_0141: 15 + 15 + 17 + 15 + 17 = 79 (the last two signs of l.6 under the stain; record about 78 = 15,15,17,15,16). l.3 and l.4 end without a divider (words run over: تعذبني, وترجع). Plain 1.4x and 2x crops of each line in thirds (y_*.png) and montages (cmp_a/b/c.png). The key was built from the words the record reads with confidence (يا, ها, مما, وخلصني, تنغصني, عسل) and then read through: the first words are يا هادمي ها دمي ("O my destroyer, here is my blood": the cup-hook is ي, the ط-like loop م as in مما; the record has هادي هادي), the 6-sign word over l.3-4 is ت ع ذ ب ن ي (the 2-hook is ب as in بهجرانك, بسي; record تعنتني), the 7-sign word is وتمغصني (record وتغصني), تصل (record نصل), وترجع (record وترج), بهجرانك (record بجرانك). اخير has the alif sign where the record has لخير. The 8-sign group on l.6 is و ز ن ا ب ي س ه with the key (record وزنا بين; the س is the sign of بسي and عسل): kept as enciphered, not understood. The last group: ت + two signs under the stain; the record's تفرصني cannot be checked. Record's plaintext certainty was low; most of its doubtful words change.
